Higher caution advised day Higher caution advised night

In detail

West Yorkshire Police recorded 3,420 crimes inside this ward's official boundary over the 3 months to July 2026 — an average of 36.7 per 1,000 residents a month, the 1st highest rate of Leeds's 33 wards. The daytime score here is driven by shoplifting (248), drugs (61), burglary (43); the evening/night score by violent crime (315), public order (97), anti social behaviour (96). Those two scores are split by offence type, not by clock time — the police feed records no time of day, so day and night here mean the kinds of crime typical of each, not counts of incidents observed then. Rated against the average of the city's own wards, never against another city.

Frequently asked questions

Is Little London & Woodhouse safe?

Wandroz currently rates Little London & Woodhouse in Leeds as an area where the data suggests extra caution relative to other neighbourhoods in Leeds, both by day and after dark. This rating is derived from West Yorkshire Police street-level crime records published at data.police.uk — an official statistic, not an assessment. High-footfall tourist, transit or shopping areas can read higher on this kind of measure without that meaning elevated risk per visit, since these statistics are normalised against registered residents rather than footfall — see the note on this page and the methodology page for the full caveats.

Is Little London & Woodhouse safe at night?

At night, Little London & Woodhouse is rated as an area where the data suggests extra caution relative to other neighbourhoods in Leeds. If you're unsure, it's worth checking recent local reviews for your specific street or block, since a neighbourhood-wide rating can't capture block-by-block variation.

Is Little London & Woodhouse a good area to stay in as a tourist?

Little London & Woodhouse's day rating (an area where the data suggests extra caution relative to other neighbourhoods in Leeds) is the more relevant one for typical daytime tourist activity; check the night rating too if you'll be out late.
